title: Supplier activation: invoice formatting, PO matching, and tax/VAT routing
text:
Supplier activation: invoice formatting, PO matching, and tax/VAT routing

['From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Liu <sophie.liu@altaircommerce.com>, Altair Commerce AP <ap@altaircommerce.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier activation: invoice formatting, PO matching, and tax/VAT routing

Hi Sophie / AP team,

Hope you’re well. Redwood Inference is the supplier for the upcoming integration work (SOW attached to our sales agreement). We’d like to get set up in Altair’s vendor portal so we can receive POs and invoice correctly. Can you confirm your vendor registration checklist and provide any inbound invoice rules? Specifically we need to know:

- Required invoice fields (PO placement, invoice numbering convention)
- Accepted file types (PDF, xml/UBL, CSV) and naming convention
- Where to place VAT/GST number and how Altair expects reverse-charge invoices for EU customers
- Bank details remit instructions and any required bank mandate form
- Whether Altair requires line-level PO matching and tolerances for quantity/price variances

Attached: Redwood_W9_Vivek_Kulkarni.pdf (stub), Sample_Invoice_ALT-0001.pdf (example).

We’re US-based (W-9) but will also invoice some EU customers through Altair’s marketplace; want to make sure VAT handling is correct.

Thanks — Vivek

', 'From: Sophie Liu <sophie.liu@altaircommerce.com>

Subject: Re: Supplier activation: invoice formatting, PO matching, and tax/VAT routing

Hi Vivek — welcome aboard. Below is the onboarding checklist and the invoice rules that Altair requires for vendor records to be activated in our AP system (Coupa). We’ve also attached the full onboarding packet and a short video walkthrough.

Required items to create vendor record:
- Legal entity name exactly as it appears on tax forms
- W-9 or W-8 (PDF) depending on tax residency
- Completed bank mandate (PDF) + copy of voided check or bank confirmation
- Remittance email and contact for payment questions
- Supplier primary contact (name/phone/email)

Invoice formatting rules (must be followed for automated matching):
- Filename pattern: ALT_INV_<VendorName>_<YYYYMMDD>_<Invoice#>.pdf or .xml
- Display the Altair PO number in the top-right labeled “PO#” (exact match required)
- Include line-level PO references: each invoice line must include the matching PO line number where applicable
- Currency must be ISO code (USD / EUR) and shown next to amounts
- VAT / Tax fields: place supplier VAT/GST number in the TAX ID box; for reverse-charge, include the phrase “Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by customer” in the tax summary section and set VAT amount to 0.00
- If reverse-charge applies, include the customer VAT ID (if provided) and reference the applicable EU directive (e.g., Art. 194)
- We accept PDF (preferred), UBL/PEPPOL XML, and CSV for bulk uploads. PDFs must be searchable text or OCR-friendly.

Payment terms and remittance:
- Standard: Net 30 from invoice receipt date (unless contract states otherwise)
- To opt into early pay, register via our EarlyPay portal in the onboarding packet (Altair pays net 10 for a 1% discount, configurable)
- Remittance email: remit@altaircommerce.com (please set this as the invoice submission address)

Next steps:
1) Fill out & sign the attached onboarding packet (DocuSign link below).
2) Upload documents to our vendor portal after you receive the vendor activation email.
3) Once the vendor record is created we will provide a Vendor ID and the first PO number for testing.

Attached: Altair_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (contains DOCS, bank mandate, and portal URL)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/altair/vendor-agreement/ABC-1234
Vendor portal: https://vendors.altaircommerce.com/register

If you’d like, we can schedule a 20-minute screen-share to walk through a sample invoice and portal upload.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Liu
Vendor Enablement Manager, Altair Commerce
sophie.liu@altaircommerce.com
-- Attachment: Altair_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (PDF)

Thanks Sophie — that’s very clear and helpful. I’ve attached our signed W-9 and a PDF sample invoice exported from our billing system. A few follow-ups:

- For the EU reverse-charge flow: when Altair creates the marketplace order and indicates reverse-charge, should Redwood omit VAT lines entirely or include VAT line with 0.00 and the textual reference? Your guidance above said include the phrase and set VAT amount to 0.00 — we’ll follow that but want to confirm if your Coupa mapping prefers 0.00 vs empty.
- Remit address: please confirm whether remit@altaircommerce.com is the only inbox we should use, or should we also send a copy to treasury@altaircommerce.com for ACH remittance reconciliation?
- For the bank mandate, I’ve attached the signed bank mandate and a voided check as one PDF. Please confirm the routing/account fields you require for US ACH (ABA routing, account number, account type).

Attached: Redwood_W9_Vivek_Kulkarni.pdf, Sample_Invoice_ALT-0001.pdf, Bank_Mandate_Redwood_signed.pdf

Thanks — Vivek
